components.css: .ds-masthead { background: var(--c-paper, #ffffff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-ink, #201a1f); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-horizon { height: 4px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #f7994e, #f3674a 30%, #d94a4c 58%, #93405c 82%, #4b3052); } .ds-masthead-inner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.75rem; min-height: 4.25rem; padding-inline: 1.5rem; } .ds-brand { margin-right: auto; color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.5rem; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand span { color: var(--c-accent, #b3261a); font-weight: 400; } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); padding-block: 0.25rem; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a.ds-current { border-bottom-color: var(--c-accent, #b3261a); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent, #b3261a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hairline Button
components.description: The only button style: transparent, hairline border that darkens to ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-hairline { padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #e2dce0); border-radius: 2px; background: none; color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.3; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-hairline:hover { border-color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); } .ds-btn-hairline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent, #b3261a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Hairline Select
components.description: Labelled select in an explainer's scenario bar.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); } .ds-select { padding: 0.35rem 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #e2dce0); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--c-paper, #ffffff); color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); font: inherit; font-weight: 400; } .ds-select:hover { border-color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); } .ds-select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--c-accent, #b3261a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Masthead search; border turns ink on focus.
components.css: .ds-search { width: 11rem; height: 2.125rem; padding-inline: 0.6rem; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #e2dce0); border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--c-ink-soft, #625a63); } .ds-search:focus { border-color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); outline: none; }

components.css: .ds-story { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 0.9rem 1.25rem; padding-block: 1.5rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #e2dce0); max-width: 36rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-kicker { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--c-accent, #b3261a); text-decoration: none; } .ds-kicker:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-story-headline { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-serif, 'Newsreader Variable', Georgia, serif); font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.16; } .ds-story-headline a { color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); text-decoration: none; } .ds-story-headline a:hover, .ds-story-headline a:focus-visible { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 0.14em; } .ds-story-summary { margin: 0.5rem 0 0; font-family: var(--font-serif, 'Newsreader Variable', Georgia, serif); font-size: 1.0625rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--c-ink-soft, #625a63); } .ds-story-date { display: block; margin-top: 0.6rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--c-ink-soft, #625a63); } .ds-story-media { width: 9rem; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #f7994e, #d94a4c 55%, #4b3052); }

components.name: Figure
components.description: Signature component: sans title, the chart, caption and source line beneath.
components.css: .ds-figure { margin: 0; max-width: 34rem; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); } .ds-figure-title { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 650; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-figure-bars div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 4rem 1fr 3rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding-block: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-figure-bars i { display: block; height: 0.9rem; background: var(--c-accent, #b3261a); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; } .ds-figure-bars b { font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; } .ds-figure-caption { margin-top: 0.7rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--c-ink-soft, #625a63); } .ds-figure-source { display: block; margin-top: 0.2rem; font-size: 0.8125rem; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Tables read as data: ink rule under the head, soft rules between rows, tabular figures.
components.css: .ds-table { border-collapse: collapse; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums lining-nums; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 0.6rem 0.9rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #e2dce0); text-align: left; } .ds-table th { font-weight: 600; vertical-align: bottom; } .ds-table thead tr { border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--c-ink, #201a1f); } .ds-table thead th { border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--c-ink, #201a1f); } .ds-table :is(th, td):first-child { padding-left: 0; } .ds-table td:not(:first-child) { text-align: right; }

components.css: .ds-tooltip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.5rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid var(--c-rule, #e2dce0); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--c-paper, #ffffff); color: var(--c-ink, #201a1f); box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-tooltip p { margin: 0; } .ds-tooltip-title { margin-bottom: 0.2rem !important; color: var(--c-ink-soft, #625a63); } .ds-tooltip b { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
priyadi.id is set like the desk of a serious newspaper where every claim arrives with its chart and its source. Serif headlines and serif prose carry the argument; a sans-serif voice handles everything that frames it: topics, bylines, captions, tables, controls. Structure comes from hairline rules, not boxes or shadows. The page should feel sober and authoritative enough to be cited in an argument, and still unmistakably one person's desk: warm, personal, signed.

The warmth comes from a single source, the logo's sunset sky, running from amber down to dusk plum. Light mode is white newsprint with plum-black ink; dark mode, the default, is the dusk end of the same sky. The sunset appears whole only as the thin horizon line across the top of every page; elsewhere it survives as one accent colour per mode, used for marks rather than surfaces.

Data is a first-class citizen. Numbers set in tabular figures, tables read as data rather than grids of cells, charts draw from the same colour tokens as the page and switch mode with it, and interactive explainers behave like instruments: labelled, precise, with numeric readouts. There is no decorative motion system; the page holds still and lets the reader work.
keyCharacteristics: Serif for what is read, sans for what frames it.
Hairline rules in two weights of meaning: soft rule for separation, ink for structure.
Flat everywhere; the only shadow belongs to floating tooltips.
One accent per mode, used as thin marks: kicker text, link underlines, focus rings, the `.id` of the wordmark.
Light and dark are equal citizens, and dark is the default.
Controls are hairline-bordered instruments with 2px corners and no fill.

rules.name: The Ember Thread Rule
rules.body: The accent is a thread, never a field. It appears as text colour, a 1–2px underline, an outline, or a small tint; it never fills a button, a panel or a background.

rules.name: The One Horizon Rule
rules.body: The full sunset gradient appears once per page, as the 4px line at the top. Do not repeat it as a divider, a button fill, a heading treatment or a chart palette.

rules.name: The Dusk Default Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is the default, not an afterthought. Every new colour, image and chart is checked on `paper-dusk` first, then on `paper`.

rules.name: The Scoped Chart Colour Rule
rules.body: A chart's categorical colours are defined per article as scoped CSS variables with a light and a dark value each (e.g. `--c-orbit`, `--c-ground`), each with one meaning throughout that article, and checked for colour-vision separation and contrast against both papers.

rules.name: The Serif Reads, Sans Frames Rule
rules.body: Anything the reader reads as argument (headlines, deks, prose, summaries) is serif. Anything that labels, locates or measures it (kickers, bylines, captions, tables, figure titles, controls, nav) is sans.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number that may be compared (table cells, chart ticks, slider outputs, verdicts) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`; tables add `lining-nums`.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: No uppercase labels and no letter-spaced eyebrows. Kickers, admonition titles and section titles are sentence case at normal tracking.

rules.name: The Two Hairlines Rule
rules.body: A soft rule (1px `rule`) separates items within a group: stories, byline, table rows, side column. An ink rule (1px `ink`, 1.5px under a table head) marks structure: the bottom of the masthead, the top of the footer, section titles, the card row, previous/next links. If a line is doing structural work, it is ink; otherwise it is soft.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: No shadow on cards, panels, controls, images or the masthead. If something needs to stand apart, give it a rule or the surface tone, not a lift.

dos: **Do** reference `--c-paper`, `--c-surface`, `--c-ink`, `--c-ink-soft`, `--c-rule`, `--c-accent` and `--font-*` in components and charts, so they follow the colour mode.
**Do** check every new piece on dusk paper first, then on white (The Dusk Default Rule).
**Do** put charts, maps and diagrams in a `<Figure>` with a title that says what it shows and the source in `source`.

**Do** make two image files (`.light` / `.dark`, with the `#gh-light-mode-only` / `#gh-dark-mode-only` suffix) for any chart or diagram exported as an image; dark files use `#17121a` or transparent, text `#efe9ea`, rules `#382e3c`.
**Do** use tabular figures for every number that can be compared.
**Do** separate with hairlines, choosing soft or ink by whether the line is structural (The Two Hairlines Rule).
**Do** build interactive controls as hairline instruments: 2px corners, `rule` border that darkens to `ink` on hover, labelled, with a numeric readout.
**Do** design every interactive figure for a phone first.
donts: **Don't** fill buttons, panels or backgrounds with the accent or the sunset gradient (The Ember Thread Rule, The One Horizon Rule).
**Don't** put shadows on anything that rests on the page; only floating tooltips get `0 2px 10px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14)`.
**Don't** publish a transparent image with dark lines as a single file, or an SVG that switches on `prefers-color-scheme`: it follows the OS, not the site's toggle.
**Don't** set prose in sans or interface furniture in serif.

**Don't** use Infima's stock emphasis fills, 8px corners or dashed drop zones for a tool; `DkimVerifier` shows the hairline version: one verdict line with a drawn icon, facts in a ruled list, detail behind a disclosure.
**Don't** use AI-generated illustrations in social cards.
